nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Summer swimming classes at the Riverside Sports Center!
Is your son or daughter bored at home?
The classes are from June second to August twenty-ninth.
There are classes for children and for adults.
Children's classes are on Mondays and Wednesdays at four o'clock in the afternoon.
Adult classes are on Tuesdays and Thursdays at half past seven in the evening.
Each class is forty-five minutes long.
A class for children is eight dollars.
A class for adults is twelve dollars and fifty cents.
A pack of ten classes is sixty dollars for children and ninety dollars for adults.
On Saturday mornings, from nine to twelve, the pool is open for families, and it's free!
The sports center is on Lake Street, next to the library.
The office is open from nine a.m. to six p.m., Monday to Saturday.
Our phone number is five five five, oh one nine two.
There are only twenty spots in each class.
